StoreNew.dc.html.title: NB7 · the Store after See them in the Store

rules.text:
How it behaves (owner 2026-11-28)

• A full-screen takeover, not a banner. Anyone who opens the app sees it; showing it needs no lock.
• All its words are in the app's main language (English in this mock).
• Shows on a cold start when the Store has books released after the last Store visit.
• Newest first, at most 5 covers. More than 5: the 4 newest plus a “+N more” tile that opens the Store; the heading gives the real count.
• Once per batch: shown once, then not again until a newer book is out. Opening the Store also counts.
• The Store stays locked as today: See them in the Store, a cover or the +N tile asks for the grown-up lock, then opens the Store with the new books on top in a “Just arrived” group (a cover: scrolled to that book). No lock is drawn on the takeover itself.
• Back to books closes it and goes to the kids' shelf, no lock.
• A push tap (Slice 471) opens this same takeover even if it was seen.

Covers are stand-ins from the design assets.

component.text:
The takeover is one component. The boards above set only how many books it shows. Change its look or words here and all five follow.

1 book: one big cover.
2 books: side by side.
3–4 books: two per row.
5 books: three on top, two below.
More than 5: four covers and a “+N more” tile.
